column1: # Built-in food list for tagging without AI (food_dataset.rs).
# One line per food:  category | flags | name;alias;alias
#   category codes: fr Fruit, veg Vegetables, gr Grains & bread, da Dairy, mf Meat & fish,
#     eg Eggs, le Legumes, nu Nuts & seeds, me Meals & dishes, sn Snacks & sweets,
#     sa Sauces & spreads, hd Hot drinks, cd Cold drinks, al Alcohol,
#     -  = a modifier word: adds (or with "-X" removes) flags, never sets the category.
#   flag codes: G Gluten, D Dairy, H High-histamine, C Caffeine, A Alcohol, S Added sugar,
#     F High-FODMAP, P Protein, B High-fiber, K High-carb
# Flags describe the food as usually made and eaten; they're approximate. High-histamine
# and High-FODMAP lists disagree with each other, and serving size matters for FODMAPs —
# these follow the commonly cited ones (SIGHI-style histamine list, Monash FODMAP) and are
# meant to be corrected per item. Names are matched as whole words, plurals folded.
